name: Poly Cubed 2017
information:
The incredible sequel to 2016's hit competition, Poly^3 2017 will have more competitors, more cubes, more pyraminx, and less 2x2. 200% less 2x2.
This competition has reached its limit of 100 competitors. If you have already registered but have not been approved you have been set on a waitlist. If anyone drops out of the competition, you will fill that spot.
This competition will be held on the campus of International Polytechnic High School and hosted through the Strategic Gaming Club. All earnings will go towards the Strategic Gaming Club.
Special thanks to SpeedCubeShop for sponsoring this competition!
